description:
Most people use their paycheck to pay bills.

In this week’s Spark to FIRE update, I break down how we turned a simple $2,500 starter account into a growing portfolio system using consistent investing, dividend income, and long-term equity growth.

This is the exact Paycheck to Portfolio framework I use to transform ordinary income into cash flow, equity, and financial momentum over time.

In this video, I walk through:
• The current Spark to FIRE account update
• How dividend layering actually works
• Why the account kept growing during a flat market
• Time-weighted return vs unrealized gains
• The 3-engine system building wealth inside the portfolio
• Why consistent capital infusion matters more than timing the market
• How ordinary paychecks can become long-term assets

This isn’t about getting rich overnight.
It’s about building a repeatable system that compounds over time.
